concept: SNS + SQS fan-out: one event to many queues
tests: How to deliver one event to several independent systems, each with its own queue.
expected: SNS topic with multiple subscribed SQS queues (fan-out). Triggers: "fan out a single event", "multiple independent systems", "each with its own queue".
why_not: One shared queue — each message goes to only one consumer; Lambda with synchronous calls — tight coupling; EventBridge with a single target is not fan-out.
